Tracing one $120,000 TFSA through three designations shows the real gap: a spouse can keep the full $120,000 sheltered either way, as long as a beneficiary spouse files Form RC240 on time, but an adult child who has used their room can re-shelter only what their own room allows, which may be just the $7,000 the 2026 limit added, or nothing.
